title: 🔆🔅IRGC Political Deputy, General Javani: Strait of Hormuz will open when America fulfills its commitments in Islamabad Memorandum of Understanding, Aug 16 in Tehran.
text:
🔆🔅IRGC Political Deputy, General Javani: Strait of Hormuz will open when America fulfills its commitments in Islamabad Memorandum of Understanding, Aug 16 in Tehran."

""
"Yadollah Javani, IRGC Political Deputy: "The Strait of Hormuz is a divine blessing and a geopolitically privileged asset for Iran; however, for years, we were deprived of effectively utilizing this blessing. This war created the conditions that allowed Iran to implement its own regulations and governance, fundamentally altering its geopolitical standing compared to the pre-war era. To the extent that the Americans, the Zionists, and their allies have been trying for months to wrest control of the Strait from Iran's hands—but they have failed. The arrangements governing the Strait of Hormuz will never return to what they were before the war.""

"Yadollah Javani, IRGC Political Deputy: "The war must end based on the memorandum of understanding, and the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz will only take place once the Americans fulfill their obligations under that memorandum. What is currently being discussed, including the status of the waterway between Iran and Oman, pertains solely to the post-war period, after the conclusion of the war is finalized.""
